kicker.zh: FATE / AI 轉型工作記錄

title.en: Making AI part of how work gets done.
title.zh: 讓 AI 融入工作的方式。

lede.en: I am Fate, a product leader putting AI to work. My journey runs from personal knowledge to departmental change and company-wide transformation.
lede.zh: 我是 Fate，一名把 AI 帶入實際工作的產品負責人。從個人知識庫出發，我逐步改造部門的工作方式，並推動公司層面的 AI 轉型。

statement.en: I design secure crypto wallets. But no wallet is truly secure. Security begins with how you use it.
statement.zh: I design secure crypto wallets. But no wallet is truly secure. Security begins with how you use it.

role.en: Product Director at a crypto wallet company
role.zh: 現任加密錢包公司產品總監

previous.en: Previously: Product Manager / Solutions Architect at Tencent
previous.zh: 曾任騰訊產品經理／解決方案架構師

journey_title.en: From my knowledge base to AI work across the company.
journey_title.zh: 從個人知識庫，到部門和公司的 AI 轉型。

text.en: Organize my materials, preserve context, and let AI work with accumulated knowledge.
text.zh: 從整理自己的材料開始，保存背景，讓 AI 能在積累的知識上工作。

text.en: Rebuild how my department tracks work, produces analysis, shares results, and hands work over.
text.zh: 改造所管理部門的進展跟進、分析、成果共享與工作交接方式。

text.en: Bring these lessons to other departments. The goal is an AI Native company, with transformation still underway.
text.zh: 開始把經驗複製到各部門。目標是成為 AI Native 公司，轉型仍在推進中。

updates_heading.zh: 記錄每一次迭代的過程。

updates_description.en: Follow the work by date: what we did, what changed, and why.
updates_description.zh: 從知識庫整理、部門管理到公司轉型，按日期記下做了什麼、改了什麼，以及為什麼改。

principle.en: I care less about how many tools we use than whether work changes and people are freed from repetition.
principle.zh: 我關心的不是用了多少工具，而是工作是否真正改變，人能否從重複勞動中解放出來。

title.zh: AI 具體幫我們做了什麼。

lede.en: Eight cases explain how we use AI in departmental management, customer support, research, financial modelling, and other work.
lede.zh: 從部門管理、客服到調研與財務建模，八個案例介紹我們怎樣把工作交給 AI。

kicker.zh: 案例 01 / AI 工作體系

title.zh: 實現部門工作管理自動化。

lede.en: AI connects a shared work baseline, new evidence, progress review, and clarification to support departmental coordination.
lede.zh: 把分散的工作信息連成可持續更新的體系，支持團隊協作與管理判斷。

title.zh: 要解決的問題與已有成果

paragraphs.en: Work information was scattered across records and conversations. Reviewing progress required people to assemble the context again.
paragraphs.zh: 工作信息分散在記錄與溝通中，每次回顧進展都需要重新拼湊背景。

paragraphs.en: A shared work list, progress overview, and focused clarification now support departmental coordination.
paragraphs.zh: 共同工作清單、進展概覽與針對性確認，已用於部門日常協調。

title.zh: 先確認一份工作項基線

paragraphs.en: AI first assembled candidate work items from existing records. We reviewed them together, merging overlaps and removing unsuitable entries.
paragraphs.zh: AI 先從已有記錄整理候選工作項，再由大家一起過，合併重複、刪去不適合作為工作項的內容。

paragraphs.en: The baseline records the purpose, owner, priority, expected outcome, and relevant timing of each item.
paragraphs.zh: 基線說清每項工作的目的、負責人、優先順序、預期結果與相關時間要求。

paragraphs.en: People confirmed that starting point. Subsequent updates refer back to it, rather than creating another disconnected list.
paragraphs.zh: 這個起點由人確認，後續更新回到同一份清單，而不是不斷另建互不相通的列表。

paragraphs.en: Inputs include meeting records, work communications, project records, and completed work. Records are read directly or provided through exports.
paragraphs.zh: 輸入包括會議記錄、工作溝通、項目記錄與已完成成果，透過直接讀取或導出材料取得。

paragraphs.en: AI matches new evidence to existing items, summarizes progress and blockers, and retains the supporting context.
paragraphs.zh: AI 把新證據歸到既有工作項，整理進展與卡點，保留支撐判斷的背景。

paragraphs.en: People review new work and conflicting information before changing the shared list.
paragraphs.zh: 遇到新工作或互相衝突的信息，先核對，再更新共同清單。

title.en: Make the same information useful to different readers
title.zh: 讓不同的人讀同一套工作事實

paragraphs.en: The work list preserves item-level detail. The overview highlights changes, questions, and decisions needing attention.
paragraphs.zh: 工作清單保留逐項細節，概覽則突出變化、問題與需要關注的決策。

paragraphs.en: Department members check their work and dependencies. The manager reviews priorities, coordination, and issues requiring a decision.
paragraphs.zh: 部門成員查看自己的工作與協作依賴，管理者查看優先順序、協調問題與待決策事項。

paragraphs.en: The dashboard gives everyone a quick view; the work list provides the detail needed for follow-up.
paragraphs.zh: 看板方便大家快速查看，工作清單則提供跟進時需要的細節。

title.en: Ask about a specific problem, then update the record
title.zh: 圍繞具體問題確認，再回到工作記錄

paragraphs.en: When an item needs clarification, AI prepares a focused question using the known facts and asks with the relevant colleagues.
paragraphs.zh: 某個工作項需要澄清時，AI 結合已知事實提出具體問題，向相關同事確認。

paragraphs.en: Confirmed answers become evidence for the next update. Commitments and material changes remain subject to human decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 有效確認成為下一次更新的證據；承諾與重大調整仍由人決定。

paragraphs.en: Routine checks stay quiet when nothing needs action. Questions and answers remain attached to the relevant work item.
paragraphs.zh: 例行檢查沒有需要行動的變化時保持安靜，問題與答覆留在對應工作項中，方便繼續跟進。

paragraphs.en: I confirmed the baseline, defined judgment and escalation rules, and review important decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 我確認工作基線，定義進展判讀和升級處理的規則，並審閱重要決策。

paragraphs.en: The dashboard is one view of the work. The shared record and human decisions keep it useful.
paragraphs.zh: 看板只是呈現方式；共同工作記錄與人的判斷，讓它能繼續服務實際工作。

kicker.zh: 案例 02 / AI 工作體系

title.en: Keep partner knowledge ready for the next task.
title.zh: 把合作溝通整理成下次能用的知識。

lede.en: AI turns conversations and materials into an evolving record that supports follow-up, decisions, and communication.
lede.zh: AI 將溝通與材料持續整理為活記錄，支撐跟進、決策與後續交流。

paragraphs.en: Partner knowledge is easily scattered across conversations and documents. Every new question can require someone to reconstruct the history.
paragraphs.zh: 合作知識容易散落在對話與文檔中，每遇到新問題，就需要有人重新拼起歷史。

paragraphs.en: AI reads updates, identifies changed facts and open questions, and connects them to the existing partner record.
paragraphs.zh: AI 讀取新內容，識別事實變化與未決問題，接回既有合作檔案。

paragraphs.en: Confirmed facts, the other party’s claims, proposals, and unresolved issues stay distinguishable. New information does not erase valid history.
paragraphs.zh: 已確認事實、對方主張、提案與待確認問題分別記錄，新信息不抹去有效歷史。

paragraphs.en: The accumulated context supports briefings and reply drafts. People approve commitments and external messages.
paragraphs.zh: 積累的背景可供生成簡報及回覆草稿；承諾與對外發送由人確認。

paragraphs.en: Partner fact pages and progress records preserve the context for later research and follow-up.
paragraphs.zh: 合作方事實頁與進展記錄，為後續研究和跟進保留背景。

paragraphs.en: The value is continuity: the next task starts from accumulated knowledge instead of another search through old conversations.
paragraphs.zh: 價值在於接續：下一項工作從已有知識開始，而不是再翻一遍舊對話。

paragraphs.en: I define which facts matter and review judgments. Colleagues contribute business context; AI organizes and maintains the record.
paragraphs.zh: 我定義重要信息與判斷標準；同事提供業務背景，AI 協助整理並維護記錄。

kicker.zh: 案例 03 / AI 工作體系

title.en: Use AI for product research and comparison.
title.zh: 讓 AI 完成產品調研與比較。

lede.en: A research question becomes evidence collection, product walkthroughs, comparable assessment, and a reviewable report.
lede.zh: 把調研問題連到證據採集、產品走查、同維度比較與可審閱的報告。

title.en: From a request to an investigation
title.zh: 從一句需求，到真正展開調研

paragraphs.en: The starting point is a product or a business question. A shared framework defines what must be examined and evidenced.
paragraphs.zh: 起點是一個產品或業務問題；共同框架明確要研究哪些方面、用什麼證據支撐。

paragraphs.en: AI helps locate official material, inspect accessible product flows, capture evidence, and organize findings under the same dimensions.
paragraphs.zh: AI 協助查找官方材料、走查可訪問的產品流程、保存證據，並按相同維度整理發現。

paragraphs.en: Reports label observed behavior, documented facts, vendor claims, and questions to investigate next.
paragraphs.zh: 報告分別標記實測行為、文件事實、對方自述與下一步要核查的問題。

paragraphs.en: Comparable sections make later reports reusable in cross-product reviews. Existing evidence can be retained when its relevance is verified.
paragraphs.zh: 相同章節讓單份報告可用於跨產品比較；已有證據經核對仍適用時，可以繼續沿用。

paragraphs.en: Completed product reports, archived screenshots, and comparative reviews support product decisions and further investigation.
paragraphs.zh: 已形成產品調研報告、截圖證據與橫向比較，支撐產品判斷與後續深挖。

paragraphs.en: AI handles much of the collection and assembly. People choose the question, judge significance, and accept the recommendation.
paragraphs.zh: AI 承擔大量取材與整理；人選擇問題、判斷意義，並決定是否採納建議。

paragraphs.en: I define the comparison framework and business relevance. AI and participating colleagues perform the research according to the research plan.
paragraphs.zh: 我定義比較框架與業務相關性，由 AI 及參與同事按調研計劃開展研究。

kicker.zh: 案例 04 / AI 工作體系

title.en: Produce external material from shared facts and standards.
title.zh: 讓 AI 依據統一事實與標準製作對外材料。

lede.en: Connect accumulated knowledge, audience requirements, terminology, and review to produce consistent material in different formats.
lede.zh: 把積累的知識、受眾要求、術語及審閱連起來，形成不同格式、口徑一致的對外材料。

title.en: A shared basis for different outputs
title.zh: 不同產出，共用同一份依據

paragraphs.en: Copy, presentations, and formal documents should not each invent their own company facts, terminology, or product descriptions.
paragraphs.zh: 文案、演講與正式文書，不應各自另造一套公司事實、術語或產品描述。

paragraphs.en: We provide the audience, purpose, constraints, and applicable facts. AI retrieves relevant knowledge and prepares a draft against those standards.
paragraphs.zh: 先明確受眾、目的、限制與適用事實，再由 AI 取用相關知識，依標準準備初稿。

title.en: From content to a reviewable artifact
title.zh: 從內容，到可以審閱的成品

paragraphs.en: AI can develop an outline, draft copy, assemble slides, and check terminology or layout. People review meaning, emphasis, and publication.
paragraphs.zh: AI 可協助形成提綱、撰寫文案、組成幻燈片並檢查術語或版式；人審閱含義、重點與發佈。

paragraphs.en: Quotations link to meeting records, and company facts follow the shared reference material.
paragraphs.zh: 發言引文附會議來源，公司與產品事實沿用共同資料。

paragraphs.en: The work has produced English copy, presentation versions, and other formal material, with reusable facts and language standards.
paragraphs.zh: 已形成英文文案、演講版本及其他正式材料，並積累可複用的事實與語言標準。

paragraphs.en: I provide the message, judgments, and audience priorities. AI helps research, structure, draft, format, and check the material.
paragraphs.zh: 我提供觀點、判斷與受眾重點；AI 協助取材、組織、起草、排版與檢查。

kicker.zh: 案例 05 / AI 工作體系

title.en: Use AI to organize reviews, coverage, and impersonation reports.
title.zh: 用 AI 整理用戶評價、報道與仿冒線索。

lede.en: AI-assisted collection, classification, deduplication, and evidence records turn scattered feedback into a reviewable report.
lede.zh: 透過 AI 輔助採集、分類、去重與證據記錄，把分散反饋轉成可審閱的報告。

paragraphs.en: Reviews and coverage are scattered across public sources. Reading them individually makes comparisons and historical follow-up difficult.
paragraphs.zh: 評價與報道散落在不同公開來源，逐條閱讀不利於比較，也難以追蹤歷史。

paragraphs.en: AI helps collect accessible material, distinguish topics and sentiment, remove duplicates, and retain references for review.
paragraphs.zh: AI 協助採集可取得的內容、辨認主題與情感、去除重複，並保留可核對的來源。

paragraphs.en: Reports separate new feedback, historical context, and leads that need follow-up.
paragraphs.zh: 報告分別整理新增反饋、歷史背景與需要跟進的線索。

paragraphs.en: For suspected impersonation, AI helps organize public evidence and prepare communication drafts. People verify the concern and decide the response.
paragraphs.zh: 對疑似仿冒線索，AI 協助整理公開證據並準備溝通草稿，由人核實問題、決定如何處置。

paragraphs.en: The practice produced archived reports and accumulated feedback records. These support communication review and issues requiring further investigation.
paragraphs.zh: 這項實踐已形成歷史報告與累積反饋記錄，支撐溝通審閱及待進一步核查的問題。

paragraphs.en: People review important findings and decide what communication or follow-up is needed.
paragraphs.zh: 人審閱重要發現，決定需要哪些溝通與後續處理。

paragraphs.en: I set the reporting questions and quality requirements. Colleagues handle business follow-up; AI supports collection, interpretation, and drafting.
paragraphs.zh: 我確定觀察問題與品質要求，同事推進具體業務處理；AI 參與採集、判讀與起草。

kicker.zh: 案例 06 / AI 工作體系

title.en: Use AI to build and revise financial models.
title.zh: 讓 AI 參與財務模型的建立與修訂。

lede.en: Connect authoritative inputs, explicit assumptions, calculation, reconciliation, and human review rather than generating an isolated forecast.
lede.zh: 把權威輸入、明確假設、計算、對賬與人工審閱連起來，而不是只生成一份孤立預測。

title.en: Give the model a grounded starting point

paragraphs.en: We define periods, metric meanings, actual inputs, and assumptions before building the model.
paragraphs.zh: 先明確期間、指標含義、實際輸入與假設，再建立模型。

paragraphs.en: AI helps organize inputs, construct scenario models, trace calculation dependencies, and revise the model when assumptions or confirmed inputs change.
paragraphs.zh: AI 協助整理輸入、建立情景模型、檢查計算依賴，並隨假設或已確認輸入變化修訂模型。

paragraphs.en: Reconciliation and historical comparisons test whether the model behaves plausibly. A desired result is not a reason to change assumptions.
paragraphs.zh: 對賬與歷史比較用來檢查模型是否合理；想得到某個結果，不能成為改假設的理由。

paragraphs.en: The work produced models, scenario summaries, and review records. Saved assumptions make later revisions easier.
paragraphs.zh: 已形成模型、情景摘要與審閱記錄，保留假設，方便後續調整再計算。

paragraphs.en: I define the business questions and challenge assumptions. AI assists modelling; finance and relevant owners verify their source inputs.
paragraphs.zh: 我定義業務問題並挑戰假設；AI 協助建模，財務及相關資料負責人核對各自輸入。

kicker.zh: 案例 07 / AI 工作體系

title.en: From manual customer support to automation.
title.zh: 人工客服向自動化的轉變。

lede.en: AI supports replies. Structured case records can also help improve future support and products.
lede.zh: AI 協助處理客服問題，沉澱下來的個案資料與經驗，也能用於後續服務和產品改進。

title.zh: 要解決的問題與已有成果

paragraphs.en: Support involved reading each conversation, finding relevant knowledge, and preparing a reply. Useful experience was hard to reuse.
paragraphs.zh: 客服需要逐封理解問題、查找知識並組織回覆，處理過的經驗也不容易再次使用。

paragraphs.en: Reply assistance, structured case knowledge, and support reports now provide a foundation for follow-up.
paragraphs.zh: 已形成回覆輔助、結構化個案知識與客服報告，為後續工作提供基礎。

title.en: From reading every message to reviewing a draft
title.zh: 從逐封處理，到確認 AI 準備的回覆

paragraphs.en: Previously, a support colleague read the conversation, checked product knowledge, found similar cases, and wrote the reply.
paragraphs.zh: 原來需要客服逐封讀取往來、查產品知識、找相似案例，再組織回覆。

paragraphs.en: AI now helps classify the issue, use relevant knowledge and earlier conversations, and prepare a draft.
paragraphs.zh: 現在由 AI 協助分類問題，結合相關知識與歷史往來，先準備回覆草稿。

paragraphs.en: The support colleague reviews the draft, adds case-specific judgment, and confirms sending. Corrections improve the material used next time.
paragraphs.zh: 客服同事審閱草稿，補充具體個案的判斷並確認發送；糾正過的內容留作下一次處理的參考。

title.en: Turn each case into usable data
title.zh: 讓每張工單留下可分析的數據

paragraphs.en: We organize the question, product context, category, handling history, and reply activity into structured case records.
paragraphs.zh: 把問題、產品背景、分類、處理過程及回覆情況整理為結構化個案記錄。

paragraphs.en: AI reads these records to prepare reports on new issues, recurring topics, response activity, and questions still awaiting follow-up.
paragraphs.zh: AI 根據這些記錄形成報告，整理新增問題、反覆出現的主題、回覆情況與仍需跟進的事項。

paragraphs.en: Managers can compare periods and topics instead of reading every ticket again.
paragraphs.zh: 管理者可以按時段和主題比較，不必為每次統計重新讀完所有工單。

title.en: Use the experience in future support
title.zh: 把處理經驗用在下一次服務

paragraphs.en: Past cases help AI find similar questions and prepare more relevant replies.
paragraphs.zh: 遇到相似問題時，AI 可以查找既有案例，準備更貼合問題的回覆。

paragraphs.en: Repeated explanations can inform help articles, reply templates, and onboarding material for colleagues.
paragraphs.zh: 反覆需要解釋的問題，可以整理為幫助文章、回覆模板與同事的培訓材料。

paragraphs.en: Corrections and effective solutions provide concrete examples for improving the support knowledge base.
paragraphs.zh: 被糾正的理解和有效處理方法，則成為完善客服知識庫的具體例子。

title.en: Use support evidence to improve products
title.zh: 把客服數據用於產品改進

paragraphs.en: Grouped feedback shows which questions recur, which product areas cause confusion, and which issues deserve further investigation.
paragraphs.zh: 按主題歸納反饋，可以看見哪些問題反覆出現、哪些功能讓用戶困惑，以及哪些事項值得進一步排查。

paragraphs.en: Product colleagues can use this evidence to prioritize investigation and improve instructions, interaction design, and support content.
paragraphs.zh: 產品同事可據此安排排查的優先順序，改進操作說明、交互設計與幫助內容。

paragraphs.en: The same records support later comparisons after a change, making customer support useful beyond the individual reply.
paragraphs.zh: 改進後仍可用同一套記錄做前後比較，讓客服的價值從回覆一封郵件，延伸到改善產品。

paragraphs.en: I define the management questions and reporting standards. Support colleagues contribute service experience; AI assists with preparation and organization.
paragraphs.zh: 我定義管理問題與報告標準；客服同事提供服務經驗，AI 協助處理與整理。

kicker.zh: 案例 08 / AI 工作體系

title.en: Write clear instructions and let AI do the work.
title.zh: 把工作寫清楚，交給 AI 執行。

lede.en: Define the goal, materials, steps, and checks so AI can execute the task and others can take it over.
lede.zh: 把工作的目標、材料、步驟和檢查標準寫清楚，交給 AI 執行，也方便其他人接手。

title.en: Define the work before handing it over
title.zh: 先定義工作，再交給 AI

paragraphs.en: We specify the purpose, intended users, required inputs, quality standards, outputs, and acceptance conditions for recurring work.
paragraphs.zh: 先說清重複工作的目的、使用人、必要輸入、品質標準、輸出與驗收條件。

paragraphs.en: AI and supporting programs then follow those definitions. Review responsibilities and consequential decisions remain explicit.
paragraphs.zh: AI 與配套程序據此執行，審閱責任和重要決策要求一併明確。

title.en: Keep the instruction tied to execution
title.zh: 讓說明書跟著實際工作變化

paragraphs.en: The instruction includes the supporting rules and materials. When the work changes, the description must change with it.
paragraphs.zh: 說明書連同配套規則與材料一起維護，工作變了，說明也要跟著變。

paragraphs.en: Execution records and feedback show what needs changing in the instruction.
paragraphs.zh: 從執行記錄與使用反饋中找出問題，再修改工作說明書。

paragraphs.en: We prepared a recurring-report work instruction, supporting rules, and handover material, then checked them against historical examples.
paragraphs.zh: 已形成重複報告工作的說明書、配套規則與交接材料，並用歷史樣本檢查。

paragraphs.en: I define standards and acceptance boundaries. AI prepares the instruction, reusable materials, and checks against the defined requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 我定義標準與驗收邊界；AI 協助形成說明書、可複用材料，並依要求檢查。

title.zh: 我對 AI 轉型的判斷。

lede.en: How to start, divide the work, and judge whether AI is helping.
lede.zh: 怎樣推動轉型、怎樣分工，以及怎樣判斷 AI 的工作有沒有用。

title.en: Buying AI tools is not transformation.

lede.en: Transformation begins when the way work is organized changes.
lede.zh: 轉型從工作組織方式的改變開始。

paragraphs.en: A tool can help one person finish faster while leaving everyone else working in the old way.
paragraphs.zh: 工具可以讓一個人做得更快，其他人卻仍按照舊方式工作。

paragraphs.en: That improvement matters, but it does not automatically become organizational capability.
paragraphs.zh: 這種改善有價值，但不會自動變成組織能力。

paragraphs.en: Who defines the result? How is work reviewed? Can useful knowledge survive the person who first produced it?
paragraphs.zh: 誰來定義結果？工作如何審閱？有用的知識能不能離開最初產出它的人而繼續存在？

paragraphs.en: These questions turn AI adoption into a management problem, rather than a shopping list.
paragraphs.zh: 這些問題，會把 AI 採用變成管理問題，而不只是採購清單。

paragraphs.en: I look for changes in responsibilities, shared standards, and how results reach the next person.
paragraphs.zh: 我會看責任、共同標準，以及成果如何到達下一個人，是否發生改變。

paragraphs.en: The question is whether better work becomes easier to repeat across the organization.
paragraphs.zh: 關鍵是：更好的工作，能否在組織中更容易重複發生。

quote.en: The change is in mechanisms, organization, and work processes, not merely in buying tools.
quote.zh: 轉型的改變在機制、組織與工作流程，不只是購買工具。

source.en: Fate, internal AI transformation kickoff, October 16, 2026, section 2.
source.zh: Fate，2026-10-16 AI 轉型啟動會紀要，§二「轉型的核心」。

title.en: Start with one task, then expand.
title.zh: 先做好一件事，再逐步推廣。

lede.en: Set the goal and standards, start with a real task, then apply what works to the next one.
lede.zh: 先定目標和標準，從一項具體工作開始，做成後再用到下一項工作。

paragraphs.en: People need a shared purpose and clear boundaries. Detailed methods can develop through real tasks and feedback.
paragraphs.zh: 人需要共同目的和清楚邊界，具體做法則可以在真實工作與反饋中形成。

paragraphs.en: An early plan should create room for learning, rather than pretend every useful application is already known.
paragraphs.zh: 早期規劃應為學習留出空間，而不是假設所有有用場景都已經知道。

paragraphs.en: My path began with personal materials. It then grew into working methods, departmental coordination, and a broader company ambition.
paragraphs.zh: 我的路徑從整理個人材料開始，逐步長成工作方法、部門協作，再走向公司層面的目標。

paragraphs.en: Each completed task revealed another problem worth solving. That is how the scope gradually expanded.
paragraphs.zh: 每做成一項工作，就發現下一個值得解決的問題，範圍因此逐步擴大。

paragraphs.en: Departmental work followed the same idea: agree on a baseline, then improve the work as new evidence arrives.
paragraphs.zh: 部門工作的做法也一樣：先確認工作基線，再隨新證據不斷改進。

paragraphs.en: A useful method needs evidence that it helps. When circumstances change, the method should be open to revision.
paragraphs.zh: 方法是否有用，需要實踐證據。情況變化時，方法也應允許修正。

paragraphs.en: I would expand only after the first task has a clear use and people can review its results.
paragraphs.zh: 我會先看第一項工作是否有明確用途、結果能否被人檢視，再決定如何擴展。

quote.en: Start with a real business task. Set direction and standards, then expand after the process works.
quote.zh: 由真正在做業務的人從小事起步，負責人提供方向與標準，跑通後再擴展。

source.en: Fate, internal AI transformation kickoff, October 16, 2026, sections 1.2 and 2.
source.zh: Fate，2026-10-16 AI 轉型啟動會紀要，§1.2 及§二。

title.en: A polished output still needs a purpose.
title.zh: 產出再漂亮，也要有人因此改變行動。

lede.en: The value of AI output depends on what happens because of it.
lede.zh: AI 產出的價值，要看它讓什麼事情發生了變化。

paragraphs.en: Documents, summaries, and dashboards are visible. Their number can grow without making a decision easier or a task better.
paragraphs.zh: 文檔、摘要、看板都很容易被看見，數量增加卻未必讓決策更容易、工作更好。

paragraphs.en: I want to know who uses a result, what they do with it, and what improves afterward.
paragraphs.zh: 我想知道誰在使用成果、用它做什麼，以及之後改善了什麼。

title.en: A reader is not always the destination

paragraphs.en: Some outputs support another process rather than a person reading every word. They still need a clear role and quality standard.
paragraphs.zh: 有些產出是供下一個環節使用，未必需要人逐字閱讀，但仍要有清楚用途與品質標準。

paragraphs.en: Producing more material for people to inspect can simply move the workload instead of reducing it.
paragraphs.zh: 把更多材料交給人檢查，可能只是轉移工作量，而不是減輕負擔。

paragraphs.en: If an output has no useful destination, revise it, combine it, or consider stopping it.
paragraphs.zh: 如果產出找不到有價值的去處，就應考慮調整、合併，或停止。

quote.en: I know AI will generate a pile of junk. I do not want junk.
quote.zh: 我知道 AI 会生成一堆垃圾，我不想要垃圾。

source.en: Fate, operations and innovation meeting, August 25, 2026, section 5: AI work loops.
source.zh: Fate，2026-08-25 運營會＋創新會紀要，§五「AI 閉環建設」，Fate 的回應。

title.zh: 管理，是把工作定義清楚。

lede.en: AI makes unclear goals and acceptance standards harder to ignore.
lede.zh: AI 讓模糊的目標與驗收標準更難被忽略。

title.zh: 一句要求裡，藏著很多取捨

paragraphs.en: A task can sound clear while leaving its scope, evidence requirements, and quality threshold unstated.
paragraphs.zh: 一項任務聽起來很清楚，範圍、證據要求與品質門檻卻可能仍未說明。

paragraphs.en: When those choices remain implicit, the result depends on someone guessing correctly.
paragraphs.zh: 這些取捨如果一直隱含著，結果就依賴別人猜得對不對。

paragraphs.en: For a recurring report, a request for a summary is not enough. Its audience, inputs, and review standard matter too.
paragraphs.zh: 例如一份重複報告，只說「整理摘要」還不夠；給誰看、依據什麼材料、怎樣審閱，同樣需要定義。

paragraphs.en: Explain the purpose, constraints, and acceptance conditions. Record the reasoning that another person needs to continue.
paragraphs.zh: 說清目的、限制與驗收條件，記下下一個人接續工作需要理解的理由。

paragraphs.en: This is management work. AI creates a stronger reason to do it well.
paragraphs.zh: 這本身就是管理工作，而 AI 讓做好它變得更重要。

paragraphs.en: A work instruction puts those choices where people and AI can use them again. It should change when the work changes.
paragraphs.zh: 工作說明書把這些取捨留下來，讓人與 AI 都能再次使用；工作變了，說明也要跟著變。

paragraphs.en: Clear definitions help execution. People still choose the priorities, resolve trade-offs, and accept the consequences.
paragraphs.zh: 清楚定義有助執行；優先順序、重要取捨及其後果，仍由人負責。

quote.en: The core work shifts from doing each task to defining how each task should be done.
quote.zh: 核心工作從做具體的活，轉向定義每項活怎麼幹。

source.en: Fate, product department meeting, October 20–21, 2026, topic 2: work instructions.
source.zh: Fate，2026-10-20—21 產品部門會紀要，議題二「工作說明書」。

title.en: Knowing what matters becomes more valuable.
title.zh: 更稀缺的，是知道該做什麼。

lede.en: Execution support increases the importance of choosing a worthwhile question.
lede.zh: 執行能力被放大之後，選對問題變得更重要。

title.en: Activity does not choose a direction
title.zh: 忙碌不會自動選出方向

paragraphs.en: Faster production does not tell us which question deserves attention. Judgment decides what evidence is needed and what can wait.
paragraphs.zh: 更快產出，不會自動告訴我們哪個問題值得關注。判斷決定需要什麼證據、哪些事情可以等待。

title.en: Be willing to challenge the story

paragraphs.en: An attractive explanation needs comparison and alternative hypotheses. The useful result may be a narrower conclusion than we expected.
paragraphs.zh: 有吸引力的解釋，需要比較與替代假設。真正有用的結果，可能是比預期更克制的結論。

paragraphs.en: I treat analysis as a way to strengthen judgment, including when it changes my original view.
paragraphs.zh: 我把分析當成加強判斷的方法，包括它推翻我原來想法的時候。

paragraphs.en: Learn to state the problem, identify missing evidence, and explain why the answer would change an action.
paragraphs.zh: 練習說清問題、辨認缺失證據，以及解釋答案會如何改變行動。

quote.en: People define the requirements, make confirmations, and expand and manage their boundaries.
quote.zh: 人負責輸出需求、做確認，並拓展和管理邊界。

source.en: Fate, product department meeting, August 13, 2026, topic 2: boundaries between people and AI.
source.zh: Fate，2026-08-13 產品部門周會紀要，議題二「AI 時代的人機邊界」。

lede.en: A new way of working needs to help people with work they actually face.
lede.zh: 新的工作方式，要能幫人處理眼前真實的工作。

paragraphs.en: A first experiment should help someone finish work they already need to do. Its benefit should be recognizable to that person.
paragraphs.zh: 第一個試驗，應該幫一個人完成本來就需要完成的工作，而且他能感受到其中的幫助。

paragraphs.en: Another report about using AI can become an extra task unless it replaces something less useful.
paragraphs.zh: 如果沒有替代低價值工作，多一份「使用 AI 的報告」可能只是增加一項任務。

paragraphs.en: Time spent checking, correcting, and moving results belongs in the evaluation. A faster draft alone is not the whole outcome.
paragraphs.zh: 檢查、糾錯與轉交成果所花的時間，也應納入評估。初稿更快，不是全部結果。

title.en: Give people a reason to continue

paragraphs.en: A useful result creates trust. Shared standards make that result easier to repeat and improve.
paragraphs.zh: 有用的結果建立信任，共同標準則讓結果更容易重複與改善。

paragraphs.en: I start with a task that helps someone, then use the result to decide what to try next.
paragraphs.zh: 我會先找一件能幫到人的工作，再根據結果決定下一步做什麼。

quote.en: The test is whether this creates more work for people. The goal is to reduce time spent, not increase it.
quote.zh: 判斷標準是有沒有讓大家更累；目標是減少時間消耗，而不是增加。

source.en: Fate, product department meeting, August 13, 2026, topic 1: departmental work management.
source.zh: Fate，2026-08-13 產品部門周會紀要，議題一結論。

title.en: What I did at each stage.
title.zh: 每個階段，我做了哪些事。

lede.en: A monthly record of knowledge-base work, departmental changes, and company-wide AI transformation.
lede.zh: 按月份記錄知識庫整理、部門工作改變，以及公司 AI 轉型的進展。

title.zh: 把材料整理成知識體系

text.en: Established a subject structure, entry points, and initial maintenance principles.
text.zh: 建立主題結構、閱讀入口與最初的維護原則。

title.zh: 讓溝通內容成為可積累的背景

text.en: Began organizing communication records alongside working materials.
text.zh: 開始把溝通記錄與工作材料一起整理。

text.en: Defined how conclusions become reviewed, reusable knowledge.
text.zh: 建立從材料提煉結論、經審閱後沉澱知識的方法。

text.en: Added explanatory material so the knowledge base can be understood beyond one conversation.
text.zh: 補充使用與維護說明，讓知識庫不只依賴一次對話。

text.en: Created an outcome record and made structured knowledge part of organizing new material.
text.zh: 建立成果記錄，讓新增材料的整理同時產生結構化知識。

text.en: Began recording metric scope and conflicting definitions together.
text.zh: 開始統一記錄指標範圍與口徑衝突。

text.en: Established clearer conventions for meeting records and their context.
text.zh: 為會議記錄及其背景建立更清楚的整理規範。

text.en: Formalized source attribution and verification requirements.
text.zh: 明確結論的來源標註與核查要求。

text.en: Completed an initial health review of structure, naming, and records.
text.zh: 完成對結構、命名與記錄的首次月度檢查。

title.en: From personal knowledge to department work
title.zh: 從個人知識走向部門工作

text.en: Established departmental progress records and a proposal for easier progress review.
text.zh: 建立部門進展記錄，設計更容易跟進工作的方式。

title.zh: 把品質要求變成共同規則

text.en: Strengthened fact checking and checks against established standards.
text.zh: 完善事實核查與既有材料的標準檢查。

title.zh: 讓進展可以被共同看見

text.en: A departmental progress board became available for review.
text.zh: 部門進展看板形成可供共同查看的成果。

text.en: Made text extraction from common working documents part of regular knowledge organization.
text.zh: 把常見工作文檔的文字提取納入日常知識整理。

title.zh: 整理 AI 轉型經驗分享

text.en: Prepared a presentation connecting personal practice, management changes, and broader transformation.
text.zh: 形成連接個人實踐、管理改變與更大轉型方向的演講材料。

text.en: Refined navigation and separation of active material from historical reference.
text.zh: 優化閱讀入口，區分現行材料與歷史參考。

title.zh: 讓錯誤成為可複用的教訓

text.en: Created a fact-based review record to preserve lessons from important mistakes.
text.zh: 建立基於事實的復盤記錄，保存重要錯誤帶來的教訓。

text.en: Expanded directory indexes to connect knowledge documents and their subject structure.
text.zh: 完善目錄索引，連接知識文件與主題結構。

text.en: Consolidated research and product material around clearer reading paths.
text.zh: 按更清楚的閱讀路徑重整研究與產品材料。

text.en: The first website presented a public overview of the work and its progress.
text.zh: 首版網站把已有工作與進展整理成公開概覽。

title.zh: 讓知識不依附單一工具

text.en: Organized instructions and knowledge for continuity across AI tools.
text.zh: 整理跨 AI 工具接續所需的指令與知識。

title.zh: 準備公司內部轉型分享

text.en: Adapted the transformation material for an internal launch discussion.
text.zh: 將轉型經驗整理為內部啟動討論的分享材料。

text.en: The internal launch brought departmental experience into a wider company transformation effort.
text.zh: 內部啟動把部門經驗帶入更大範圍的公司轉型工作。

title.zh: 把工作寫成可交接的說明

text.en: Prepared a recurring-report work instruction and supporting handover materials.
text.zh: 形成重複報告工作的說明書與配套交接材料。

title.en: Make recurring work easier to continue
title.zh: 讓重複工作更容易接續

text.en: Organized reporting requirements, supporting material, and handover records so colleagues can continue the work.
text.zh: 整理報告的工作要求、配套材料與交接記錄，方便其他同事接手。

text.en: Consolidated meeting materials while preserving originals and subject references.
text.zh: 集中整理會議材料，保留原件與業務主題的引用。

title.en: Prepare cases, thoughts, and a timeline for the website
title.zh: 為網站整理案例、思考與時間軸

text.en: Organized practice cases and meeting-based reflections into separate pages, with a timeline linking the main milestones.
text.zh: 把實踐案例和來自會議記錄的思考整理為獨立頁面，並用時間軸串起重要事件。

title.en: Product, curiosity, and the work in between.
title.zh: 產品、好奇心，與其間的實踐。

lede.en: I am Fate. Product Director at a crypto wallet company. Previously, a Product Manager and Solutions Architect at Tencent.
lede.zh: 我是 Fate，現任加密錢包公司產品總監，曾任騰訊產品經理／解決方案架構師。

paragraphs.en: Fate leads product at a crypto wallet company serving consumers in North America and Europe.
paragraphs.zh: Fate 在一家面向北美與歐洲消費者的加密錢包公司負責產品。

paragraphs.en: Since August 2026, the role has also involved building a knowledge base and AI platform for the product department.
paragraphs.zh: 2026 年 8 月起，這份工作多了另一半：搭建一個產品部門能跑在上面的知識庫與 AI 平台。

paragraphs.en: Departmental coordination is gradually moving into this way of working, one piece at a time.
paragraphs.zh: 並把部門的組織協調工作，一件一件交給它。

paragraphs.en: Most of this work is invisible from outside. This website makes it legible: what exists, how it works, and what changed.
paragraphs.zh: 這些工作從外面幾乎看不見。這個網站把它變得可讀：有什麼、做得怎樣、改了什麼。

paragraphs.en: It will grow to cover career background, writing, and other channels.
paragraphs.zh: 之後會逐步加入職業背景、寫作與其他渠道。

paragraphs.en: NFT enthusiast. E/acc. Best dad ever.
paragraphs.zh: NFT enthusiast · E/acc · Best dad ever。

paragraphs.en: I design secure crypto wallets. But no wallet is truly secure. Security begins with how you use it.
paragraphs.zh: 我設計安全的加密錢包。但沒有錢包能保證絕對安全，安全始於你的使用方式。

paragraphs.en: I welcome conversations about crypto products, practical AI transformation, collaboration, and professional opportunities.
paragraphs.zh: 歡迎交流加密產品、AI 轉型實踐、合作與職業機會。

paragraphs.en: If you are bringing AI into team work, I would be glad to exchange experiences.
paragraphs.zh: 如果你也在探索如何讓 AI 進入團隊的真實工作，歡迎交流實踐中的經驗與問題。

contact_note.zh: 歡迎交流加密產品、AI 轉型，以及更好的工作方式。
